add_ons_price.name: add_ons_price
add_ons_price.value:
(
    "add_ons"."price_usd" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.-]*'
    AND "add_ons"."price_usd" GLOB '*.[0-9][0-9]'
    AND ("add_ons"."price_usd" GLOB '[0-9]*' OR "add_ons"."price_usd" GLOB '-[0-9]*')
    AND length("add_ons"."price_usd") - length(replace("add_ons"."price_usd", '.', '')) = 1
    AND instr(substr("add_ons"."price_usd", 2), '-') = 0
  )

flash_credit_kind.name: flash_credit_kind
flash_credit_kind.value:
("flash_credit_entries"."kind" = 'top_up' AND "flash_credit_entries"."amount_usd" NOT GLOB '-*' AND "flash_credit_entries"."card_brand" IS NOT NULL AND length("flash_credit_entries"."card_last4") = 4)
        OR ("flash_credit_entries"."kind" = 'spend' AND "flash_credit_entries"."amount_usd" GLOB '-*' AND "flash_credit_entries"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("flash_credit_entries"."kind" = 'stream' AND "flash_credit_entries"."amount_usd" NOT GLOB '-*' AND "flash_credit_entries"."stream_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "flash_credit_entries"."stream_payment_no" IS NOT NULL AND "flash_credit_entries"."stream_payment_no" >= 1
            AND "flash_credit_entries"."order_id" IS NULL AND "flash_credit_entries"."card_brand" IS NULL AND "flash_credit_entries"."card_last4" IS NULL)

media_key_relative.name: media_key_relative
media_key_relative.value: "media"."key" NOT GLOB '/*' AND "media"."key" NOT LIKE '%..%' AND "media"."key" NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z]:*' AND instr("media"."key", '\') = 0

orders_payment.value:
("orders"."payment_method" = 'card' AND "orders"."flash_credit_usd" = '0.00' AND "orders"."card_brand" IS NOT NULL AND length("orders"."card_last4") = 4 AND "orders"."card_last4" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
        OR ("orders"."payment_method" = 'flash_credit' AND "orders"."flash_credit_usd" = "orders"."total_usd" AND "orders"."card_brand" IS NULL AND "orders"."card_last4" IS NULL)
        OR ("orders"."payment_method" = 'split' AND "orders"."flash_credit_usd" NOT IN ('0.00') AND "orders"."flash_credit_usd" NOT GLOB '-*' AND "orders"."card_brand" IS NOT NULL AND length("orders"."card_last4") = 4 AND "orders"."card_last4" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
